mechanism: Both are monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) with additive inhibition of MAO enzymes, leading to dangerous accumulation of monoamines (serotonin, norepinephrine, dopamine) and risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome.
action: Absolute contraindication: do not combine selegiline with isocarboxazid or any other MAOI; allow 14-day washout period between agents.
